headline: Safety Officer (SO2)
summary: Construction safety officer with five years on road, building and mining-support projects in Caraga. I inspect sites daily, set up temporary facilities safely, lead emergency drills, audit subcontractors and report incidents and risks to management. I also check that completed structures are maintained safely.
skills: Maintenance checks of structures and scaffolds

experience.title: Safety Officer (SO2)
experience.employer: Agusan del Norte Road and Building Contractors
bullets: Inspect active sites daily and stop unsafe work until it is corrected.
Plan and lead emergency drills for fire, earthquake and flooding.
Audit subcontractors' safety compliance and report monthly to the project manager.
Investigate incidents and near misses and follow up corrective actions.
Check scaffolds, bunkhouses and temporary power before use.

experience.title: Safety Inspector
bullets: Inspected haul roads, workshops and equipment for hazards.
Kept safety records and permits for the site office.

education.credential: Bachelor of Science in Industrial Engineering
